decisions.reason: The award and positive public recognition increase commitment, making dropping unlikely despite sunk costs.
Its prominent home-page launch and explicit public commitment create strong escalation pressure to keep the product.
Only a brief website mention indicates lower public commitment, but sunk costs and the short time frame favor persistence.
With minimal public visibility, dropping would be easier, but existing investments still encourage keeping the product.
The launch quote positions it as part of the new offer, creating visible commitment that management will likely justify by keeping it.
